dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Yeah, people here usually band together in groups of four to go on adventures.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: You seem to be in good company.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: I once belonged to a rather nice team... But "Unlucky Bennett" was also there...

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: We all thought it was just a joke about him being "unlucky," but...

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: All the commissions he took on, somehow always failed in the least expected way...

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Come to think of it, it is rather strange.
